whyItMatters: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a manifest that accepts whatever version the baseline resolves.
actions: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix a manifest that accepts whatever version the baseline resolves.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm vcpkg.json no longer carries a manifest that accepts whatever version the baseline resolves.
